bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src="5bac2a001e3617dcb44214158059349a54cf8cff"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-autoack-5bac2a0-20261119"

test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 61

git -C "$root" merge-base --is-ancestor "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)" "$src" || exit 63
